QuestInfo.name: [Edelstein] Eliminate Strange Signs
QuestInfo.0: The cowardly #bPolice Officer #p2152003##k in #b#m310000000##k has a favor to ask you.
QuestInfo.1: #p2152003# tells you that many visitors are getting lost, because the signposts have been broken. She wants you to teach a lesson to the #r#o1150001#s#k. Go to #b#m310030100##k, located on the right side of the town, to find them.\n\n#o1150001##r #a239131##k
QuestInfo.2: You returned after teaching the #o1150001#s a lesson.

0.0: Oh, hello. Welcome to #m310000000#! Feel free talk to me if there is anything I can do for you! As a police officer, I am available to help you with anything besides squashing bugs! Although, I'm the one who needs help right now... Can I ask you for a favor?

yes.0: There are a lot of people visiting #m310000000# because the Black Wings have been negligent in their surveillance these days, and the broken signs have been confusing them. Can you please teach the #r#o1150001# enemies#k a lesson? Punish about #r50#k of them... Thank you!
yes.1: There should be a lot of them near the #b#m310030100##k. They are old and worn out, so they should be easy to spot.

no.0: I-I'm so sorry. How could a police officer ask help... I'm not qualified to be a police officer! And I'm really scared of bugs! Aaah!

1.0: Have you really defeated all of the #o1150001#s? That's amazing... Thank you so much! You've really helped #m310000000#! Let me thank you on behalf of #m310000000#, not that I represent... What I mean is... Let me thank you on behalf of the police!

yes.0: I'm sorry that I'm such a bad police officer. There used to be a more dependable police officers around, but ever since the Black Wings took over... Well, most of them disappeared fighting them. The only police officers left are new like me. Please try to understand.

mob.0: Oh? You haven't been able to take care of the #r#o1150001# enemies#k at the #b#m310030100##k? Was #r50#k too many? But I don't think any less would be very effective...
